author: Aevy TV
description:
You see an ad. What you don’t see is everything that had to happen for that ad to reach you. And InMobi is one of the companies powering that invisible technology.

InMobi is a global internet and AI company born in India and used around the world. Behind the ads you see inside apps, InMobi’s technology helps decide which ad shows up, all in a fraction of a second.

And the scale is truly wild. InMobi Advertising reaches 2 billion+ users across 150+ countries and works with 50,000+ brands globally.

Now, InMobi is making its next big bet with Glance, an intelligent shopping agent designed to find what you might like before you even start searching.

What makes the InMobi story interesting isn’t just its scale. InMobi became India’s first unicorn in 2011, long before India’s startup boom, and went on to build technology used across global markets.
title: How InMobi built the AI engine behind ads. #ad
